provenance: Idealized, independently simulated circular step-index SMF; public core size and width scale, assumed index profile. No measured sample, vendor profile, or real-device tolerance.
guide: Circular step-index single-mode fiber in effectively infinite silica cladding; normal, uncoated facet at z=0.
source: Forward x-polarized HE11-like guided mode, no incoming wave from air.
frame: World origin at guide center on facet. t=+X, s=+Y, d=+Z. Fixed center and zero tilt.
phasor: exp(+i omega t), forward exp(-ikz); conjugate the exported FMMAX spatial phasors
budget_provenance: 0.10 dB nominal per-Port Gaussian representation allocation carried over from M7-R5, including 0.01 dB numerical reserve. No customer/real-device loss specification.
core_source: Nominal 8.2 um core diameter from Corning PI1450 (2015), assumed positive step index 0.0045; independent engineering assumption.
width_context: Corning PI1424, 1310 nm MFD 9.2 +/- 0.4 um; context only, not prescribed to solver.
